blocks.x: From revenue collector and magistrate to **coordinator of development and disaster**.
blocks.in: District Election Officer, chair of the **DDMA under the DM Act, 2005**, census officer, land acquisition authority, and chair of dozens of committees.
blocks.w: **Role overload** is the defining problem — the office accumulates duties and sheds none.

blocks.t: The reform debate on the Collector
blocks.x: Should the office shed development or shed regulation?
blocks.th: **First ARC** wanted it freed of regulatory work for development; the **Second ARC (6th Report)** wanted the opposite — withdraw from development, leaving it to the Zila Parishad CEO.
blocks.in: Neither has happened; the Collector still chairs both.
blocks.gl: Separation of prefectoral and elected local roles in Europe.
blocks.w: The two ARCs point in **opposite directions** — say which you would follow and why.

blocks.t: District as the unit of development
blocks.x: Large enough for technical capacity, small enough to know the terrain.
blocks.th: **G.V.K. Rao Committee (1985)** — 'grass without roots', recommended a District Development Commissioner and the district as the planning unit.
blocks.in: District Planning Committee (243ZD); Aspirational Districts with a Prabhari Officer and delta ranking.
blocks.w: The district works as a **convergence unit**, which is why ADP chose it.

blocks.x: **Division → district → sub-division → tehsil → circle → village**, with a parallel development line through the Block.
blocks.in: SDM, Tehsildar, Kanungo, Patwari; **BDO** on the development side; the Patwari remains the state's real point of contact with land.
blocks.w: Land records digitisation matters because the **Patwari is the interface**.

blocks.x: Most citizen contact with the state happens at district level and below.
blocks.in: Certificates, land mutation, ration, pensions, policing; single-window district service centres and Public Service Guarantee Acts.
blocks.w: Service guarantee laws work because default carries a **personal penalty** on the officer.

blocks.x: The 73rd Amendment created an elected district tier alongside an appointed Collector — an unresolved duality.
blocks.in: Zila Parishad chairperson versus Collector; who chairs the DPC varies by state.
blocks.gl: Elected county executives in the US.
blocks.w: Genuine devolution requires the Collector to **step back from development**, which states have not done.
